name: aidlc-harness
description: Quality kit for building software with AI agents in the AI-DLC cycle: an Inception that drafts everything and asks at most five questions in the tool's own question window, phases approved by a person, a gate that refuses "done" without the raw test output, and an identity scanner. One command prepares a project for 15 AI tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex, Kiro, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and more) and 10 stacks. The kit's messages and prompts are in Brazilian Portuguese.

gate_mode.title: Modo do gate de qualidade
gate_mode.description: block: barra o encerramento sem evidência. warn: só avisa. off: desligado. Vale para os hooks de Stop (dod-check, promise-check).
